{"name":"4e867d3dc6b982ab03bc","layouts":[{"id":0,"position":{"x":11.461649782923299,"y":89.60926193921853,"z":2000,"width":1256.6136034732272,"height":614.7612156295224,"tabOrder":0}}],"singleVisual":{"visualType":"textbox","drillFilterOtherVisuals":true,"objects":{"general":[{"properties":{"paragraphs":[{"textRuns":[{"value":"E-Referrals ","textStyle":{"fontWeight":"bold","fontFamily":"Arial","fontSize":"14pt"}}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":"[CCG_Sandbox].[dbo].[EReferrals]","textStyle":{"fontSize":"13.3333px"}}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":""}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":"In England, e-RS is a national digital platform used to refer patients from primary care into elective care services. e-RS allows patients to choose their first outpatient hospital or clinic appointment and book it in the GP surgery, online or on the phone. This dashboard captures the number of E-Referals via the NHS e-Referral Service (e-RS) for patients registered to a Gloucestershire GP practice (11M). This includes referrals into directly bookable services as well as referral assessment triage requests which can be further split by specialty, provider and priority (2WW, Ugenrt, Routine). ","textStyle":{"fontFamily":"Arial","fontSize":"12pt"}},{"value":"The following analysis illustrates the E-Referral activity for all patients registered to a Gloucestershire GP Practice (11M). ","textStyle":{"fontSize":"12pt"}},{"value":"Any onward referrals from a traige request are not counted to avoid double counting however converted A&G requests are captured within the directly bookable figures. E-referral specialty is established using the main specialty code. ","textStyle":{"fontSize":"16px"}},{"value":"E-referral specialty is established using the main specialty code. ","textStyle":{"fontFamily":"Arial","fontSize":"12pt"}}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":""}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":"E-Referral Rejections","textStyle":{"fontFamily":"Arial","fontSize":"12pt","textDecoration":"underline"}}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":"The number of referrals sent via eRS that were rejected by the provider. This occurs if the provider clinician feels that their service is not clinically appropriate for the patient and/or there are more suitable alternative ways of optimising patient care, they may choose to return the referral and advise the referrer accordingly. Rejections from the Referral assessment service are established by a triage outcome of 'Return to Referrer with Advice'. ","textStyle":{"fontFamily":"Arial","fontSize":"12pt"}}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":""}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":""}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":"Advice and Guidance","textStyle":{"fontWeight":"bold","fontFamily":"Arial","fontSize":"14pt"}}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":"[CCG_Current].[EReferrals].[vw_AdviceAndGuidance], [CCG_Current].[Cinapsis].[vw_ReferralManagement]","textStyle":{"fontSize":"13.3333px"}}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":""}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":"The A&G Service enables GPs to request advice from identified specialists who can support GPs in managing medication and treatment plans for patients, and advise on interpretation of results. This service is a key part of the Elective Care Transformation Programme’s work to ensure patients see the right person, in the right place, first and every time. This dashboard illustrates the number of A&G referrals made via both the Advice and Guidance service as well as via Cinapsis for patients registered to a Gloucestershire GP practice (11M). This can be further split by specialty and provider. ","textStyle":{"fontFamily":"Arial","fontSize":"12pt"}}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":""}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":""}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":"Referral Assessment Service ","textStyle":{"fontWeight":"bold","fontFamily":"Arial","fontSize":"14pt"}}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":" [CCG_Sandbox].[dbo].[Referral_Assessment_Service_Total]","textStyle":{"fontSize":"13.3333px"}}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":""}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":"The Referral Assessment Service (RAS) allows providers to assess the Clinical Referral Information from the GP/referrer without the need for an appointment being booked and decide on the most appropriate onward clinical pathway. Providers are able to contact the patient to discuss choice (if an elective referral), arrange an appointment where needed and return the triage request to the original referrer with advice, if an onward referral is not required. This facility supports complex care pathways, such as gastroenterology and cardiology, where it's not always clear whether a patient needs a consultant appointment or a diagnostic test. A RAS set up by the provider will ensure patients' referrals are triaged correctly. This dashboard illustrates the number of requests via the Referral Assessment Services (RAS) for patients registered to a Gloucestershire GP practice (11M) which can be further split by service, triage outcome and priority. ","textStyle":{"fontFamily":"Arial","fontSize":"12pt"}}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":""}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":""}]}]}}]},"vcObjects":{"title":[{"properties":{"titleWrap":{"expr":{"Literal":{"Value":"true"}}}}}],"background":[{"properties":{"show":{"expr":{"Literal":{"Value":"true"}}},"transparency":{"expr":{"Literal":{"Value":"0D"}}}}}],"general":[{"properties":{"keepLayerOrder":{"expr":{"Literal":{"Value":"true"}}}}}],"visualHeader":[{"properties":{"show":{"expr":{"Literal":{"Value":"false"}}},"transparency":{"expr":{"Literal":{"Value":"0D"}}}}}],"border":[{"properties":{"radius":{"expr":{"Literal":{"Value":"0D"}}}}}]}}}
